entries.3340efddd387435d: A sales promotion services and general printing company that, mainly for the retail distribution industry, provides integrated support from sales promotion planning through production and printing to digital measures.
entries.3d417147fe8fad42: A business that manufactures printed matter, including inserted advertising flyers, at the printing and processing facilities of the Saitama Plant and Wakayama Plant. The main raw material is paper.
entries.8a535763932c43aa: A single-segment business that serves retail distribution companies as its main customers, providing sales promotion, planning and management of sales promotion management systems, digital marketing via WEB and SNS, and commercial printing. It has printing and processing facilities at its Saitama Plant in Niiza, Saitama Prefecture, and its Wakayama Plant in Wakayama Prefecture, and handles everything from planning, design and production through to printing in-house. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥9,967 million.
entries.8fb4adb5152fb80a: Planning and management of sales promotion management systems
entries.a910897f019e45ac: Companies in the retail distribution industry
entries.b3cd0e3d017405d6: A service that plans and manages the company's proprietary sales promotion management system, which streamlines sales promotion operations, and supports the operation of customers' sales promotion activities.
entries.d9d27f4ee512dbcf: A service that supports retailers' sales promotion challenges consistently, from designing marketing strategies through planning, production, execution and effect verification.
entries.f3c0123c43f5058f: A service that plans and provides digital marketing measures using WEB and SNS, and supports sales promotion activities that span real and digital channels.
